name: 游侠笑传II
english_name: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II
english_description: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II, live since October 1999. Its sect map is a Jin Yong multi-novel crossover spanning Shaolin, Huashan, Emei, Songshan, and Taishan (The Smiling, Proud Wanderer's Five Mountain Schools) alongside Mingjiao and the Sun Moon Holy Cult's Black Wood Cliff from the same novel, the Ancient Tomb sect and Quanzhen Sect from Return of the Condor Heroes, Peach Blossom Island from Legend of the Condor Heroes, the Vulture Palace from Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils, and the Divine Dragon Cult from The Deer and the Cauldron. Admin rank uses its own Chinese title scheme ('主管巫师', not the usual bracketed '(admin)'). Supports dual-encoding clients — after connecting, players choose GB or BIG5 encoding, and the BIG5 prompt line deliberately appears garbled when viewed under GBK, an intentional design touch rather than an encoding bug. Registration runs through encoding choice, English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, talent selection (y to accept), email, and gender.
